WITH scoped AS (
  SELECT
    o.id,
    o.owner_user_id,
    o.tenant_id,
    o.currency_code,
    o.amount,
    o.is_won,
    o.closed_at,
    o.created_at,
    t.name AS merchant,
    u.full_name AS rep_name
  FROM opportunities o
  JOIN tenants t ON t.id = o.tenant_id
  JOIN pipelines p ON p.id = o.pipeline_id AND p.tenant_id = o.tenant_id AND p.name = 'New business'
  JOIN users u ON u.id = o.owner_user_id AND u.tenant_id = o.tenant_id
  WHERE t.name IN ('Ballycorran Industrial Supply','Castell Fasteners','Hanse Industriebedarf','Midland Safety Wear','Polder Packaging')
    AND o.is_closed = true
),
rated AS (
  SELECT
    s.*,
    CASE
      WHEN s.currency_code = 'EUR' THEN s.amount
      ELSE s.amount / (
        SELECT er.rate
        FROM exchange_rates er
        WHERE er.base_code = 'EUR'
          AND er.quote_code = s.currency_code
          AND er.as_of <= s.closed_at::date
        ORDER BY er.as_of DESC
        LIMIT 1
      )
    END AS amount_eur
  FROM scoped s
)
SELECT
  rep_name,
  merchant,
  COUNT(*) AS opportunities_closed,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE is_won) AS closed_won,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT is_won) AS closed_lost,
  ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE is_won) / COUNT(*), 1) AS win_rate_pct,
  ROUND(AVG(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (closed_at - created_at)) / 86400.0)::numeric, 1) AS avg_days_open,
  ROUND(AVG(amount_eur)::numeric, 2) AS avg_amount_eur
FROM rated
GROUP BY owner_user_id, rep_name, merchant
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 3
ORDER BY win_rate_pct ASC, opportunities_closed DESC, rep_name ASC
note: Filtered by the 5 confirmed tenant names and each tenant's own 'New business' pipeline, as specified. Note: the report itself only lists reps with >=3 closed opportunities (per the grain, one row per qualifying rep); the count of reps excluded by that threshold is not a row in this table and would need a separate quick count if wanted for the memo.
